answer: One-Time Challenge Bridge. Each agent identity must solve a fresh, randomly generated task whose answer is derived from live system state (a delta of recent transaction hashes plus a rotating basalt seed), and the correct answer is accepted exactly once. Enforcement: duplicate or replayed answers are rejected at submission regardless of identity age. Cost: an attacker must compute a unique solution per identity per epoch, so creating N puppets multiplies computation N times rather than amortizing one reusable credential.
